reason: Concrete long-only US equity trend-following rules using weekly breakouts, ROC confirmation, regime filter and percentage trailing stops that can be approximated on daily bars.

setup.quote: you've just got to close above the highest high of the past 20 weeks
rate of change over those 20 weeks is above a certain level ... above 30

entry.rule: buy on 20-week breakout with ROC>30% when regime filter true
entry.quote: 20 week breakout if the rate of change is above 30 then bang we've got a buy signal

stop.rule: 20% trailing stop from recent high, ratchet to 10% when regime turns down
stop.quote: trailing stop somewhere in the vicinity ... 20% behind the position ... ratchet that up to 10 percent

exits.rule: exit next open if close below trailing stop
exits.quote: has to close below that ... execute the exit on the open the next day

sizing.rule: 5% fixed equity per position, max 20 positions
sizing.quote: allocate 5% of our capital to each one of those positions ... 20 positions

market_filter.rule: only buy when S&P 500 above its 200-day MA
market_filter.quote: only gonna take buy signals if the S&P 500 is above its 200 day moving average

ambiguities.issue: system described as weekly but engine is daily
ambiguities.assumption: approximate 20-week high and Friday close logic on daily bars

ambiguities.issue: exact trail stop calculation not fully specified
ambiguities.assumption: standard ATR-independent percentage trailing stop from highest close
